title: Resource pack metadata
description: Metadata for a Minecraft resource pack.

pack.title: Pack info
pack.description: Basic resource pack information. Modern versions should use min_format/max_format; pack_format is kept for backward compatibility.

description.title: Description
description.description: The description text or text component shown in the resource pack list.

min_format.title: Minimum pack format
min_format.description: The minimum pack format version this pack is compatible with. Minor version can be written as [major, minor], e.g. [88, 0].

max_format.title: Maximum pack format
max_format.description: The maximum pack format version this pack is compatible with. Minor version can be written as [major, minor], e.g. [88, 0].

pack_format.title: Legacy pack format
pack_format.description: Legacy pack format field, retained for compatibility in modern versions.

supported_formats.title: Legacy supported formats
supported_formats.description: Legacy pack format range field, retained for compatibility in modern versions.

filter.title: Filter lower-priority resources
filter.description: Specifies resources to block from lower-priority resource packs.

namespace.description: The namespace to match; matches all namespaces when omitted.

path.description: The resource path regex to match; matches all paths when omitted.

overlays.title: Overlay packs
overlays.description: Defines overlay resource pack directories that apply at different format versions.

entries.description: List of overlay directories. The game reads them from bottom to top.

language.title: Additional languages
language.description: Adds additional languages to the language menu.

propertyNames.description: Language code must be 1 to 16 characters long.

min_inclusive.description: The minimum major format version included in the range.

max_inclusive.description: The maximum major format version included in the range.

directory.description: Overlay directory relative to the resource pack root. Can only contain a-z, 0-9, underscores, and hyphens.

min_format.description: The minimum format version this overlay is active for.

max_format.description: The maximum format version this overlay is active for.

formats.description: Legacy overlay format range field, retained for compatibility in modern versions.

name.description: The full name of the language.

bidirectional.description: When true, the language is displayed right-to-left.
